cues.en: If you are already an amazing python programmer with years of experience with Python programming then that's great.
cues.zh: 如果你已經是有多年經驗、很厲害的 Python 程式設計師，那很好。

cues.en: You don't have to worry about the little details of coding in this course but I'm guessing that you probably are not a total expert in Python.
cues.zh: 這門課的程式細節就不用擔心了。但我猜，你可能還不是 Python 專家。

cues.en: Maybe you are completely new to Python.
cues.zh: 也許你完全沒學過 Python。

cues.en: Maybe have a little bit of experience with Python but you're not really so comfortable.
cues.zh: 也許有一點經驗，但還不太熟練。

cues.en: So I want to have this video that is just going to tell you a little bit about how to get help when you are stuck in Python.
cues.zh: 所以這段影片想簡單說明，在 Python 裡卡住時，怎麼尋求幫助。

cues.en: And this is the kind of situation where you know what you want to do you know what you want the computer to do.
cues.zh: 也就是你知道自己要做什麼，也知道希望電腦做什麼，

cues.en: You're just not really sure exactly how to implement it in Python.
cues.zh: 只是不確定該如何用 Python 實作。

cues.en: So here's the correct order for getting help when you're stuck in Python.
cues.zh: Python 卡關時，尋求協助的正確順序是這樣。

cues.en: First of all you try things in Python.
cues.zh: 首先，自己在 Python 裡試試。

cues.en: Next you search online and then you look through the Q&A forum -- the question and answer forum -- in this course.
cues.zh: 接著上網搜尋，再查看這門課的 Q&A，也就是問答討論區。

cues.en: So let me spend a moment talking about each one of these options.
cues.zh: 我分別花一點時間說明這些選擇。

cues.en: So your first line of defense should be going directly to Python and just you know trying out stuff in Python.
cues.zh: 第一道防線，就是直接到 Python 裡動手試。

cues.en: It's only going to help. One of my favorite things about coding and one thing that makes coding better than real life.
cues.zh: 這只會有幫助。寫程式有個我很喜歡的優點，也是比現實生活好的地方，

cues.en: There's always an undo; you can always go back and undo your changes. So never hesitate to just start trying stuff when you're confused.
cues.zh: 就是永遠可以復原，隨時能撤銷變更。所以感到困惑時，別猶豫，先試試看。

cues.en: Just try a bunch of stuff and you know make sure you have a backup of the good code, the working code, so you don't lose anything.
cues.zh: 多試幾種做法，也要確保已備份好的、能正常執行的程式碼，避免損失。

cues.en: And there's also ways to get help on specific functions as they're called help files or sometimes they're
cues.zh: 也有針對特定函數取得說明的方法，叫做說明文件，有時也，

cues.en: called Doc strings and you access these Doc strings by pressing shift tab inside of a function.
cues.zh: 稱為 docstring。在函數裡按 Shift+Tab，就能查看。

cues.en: So I'm going to switch to Python now and show you what I mean by these two points. So here we are in Python in a Jupiter IPython notebook.
cues.zh: 我現在切到 Python，示範這兩點。這裡是 Jupyter IPython Notebook 裡的 Python。

cues.zh: 這裡有個 abs 函數，

cues.en: And then there's just an empty set of parentheses so whenever you see a bunch of letters and then parentheses afterwards that indicates that this is a function.
cues.zh: 後面接一對空括號。當你看到一串字母，後面有括號，代表這是一個函數。

cues.en: So what does this function abs mean?
cues.zh: abs 這個函數是什麼意思？

cues.en: Well, we're not at the gym so I'm guessing that this is not something about doing core workouts.
cues.zh: 這裡不是健身房，所以我猜不是練核心肌群的意思。

cues.en: Maybe it's something about the absolute value of a number.
cues.zh: 也許是數字的絕對值。

cues.en: So I'm just going to try; I'm just going to put in the number four and now to run this code I'm going to press control enter on my keyboard and then we get the answer for ha.

cues.zh: 和原本的數字一樣。

cues.zh: 如果輸入 -4 會怎樣？

cues.en: Then the answer is still 4.
cues.zh: 答案仍然是 4。

cues.en: So that seems to be the absolute value of this number.
cues.zh: 看起來確實是取絕對值。

cues.en: And now I'm just going to try some other random things.
cues.zh: 我再隨便試試其他東西。

cues.en: What happens if I type.
cues.zh: 如果輸入，

cues.en: Maybe just some strings in here.
cues.zh: 也許隨便一些文字，會怎樣？

cues.en: Aha.
cues.zh: 啊。

cues.en: Well now I get an error and it says that name SDF is not defined.
cues.zh: 現在出現錯誤，說名稱 SDF 尚未定義。

cues.en: That's because there is no variable called SDF.
cues.zh: 因為沒有叫 SDF 的變數。

cues.en: So I'm just trying to illustrate a few different ways of testing out things in python just to see what happens and to read the error messages.
cues.zh: 我只是示範幾種在 Python 裡測試的方法，看看會發生什麼，並閱讀錯誤訊息。

cues.en: So here I put in two separate numbers to input arguments and the error was that this function abs takes exactly one argument.
cues.zh: 這裡輸入兩個不同數字，也就是兩個輸入引數，錯誤訊息說 abs 函數只接受一個引數。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So you can do a little bit of trial and error testing and that will help you figure out stuff.
cues.zh: 做一些試誤測試，就有助於弄懂問題。

cues.en: And then if you put the cursor inside the parentheses here then press shift and then tab on your keyboard
cues.zh: 接著把游標放在這裡的括號內，按住 Shift，再按 Tab，

cues.en: and that's going to bring up this little window here.
cues.zh: 就會出現這個小視窗。

cues.en: This is called the help file or the doc string.
cues.zh: 這叫說明文件，或 docstring。

cues.en: Now sometimes these help files are really really helpful and they explain things very clearly.
cues.zh: 有時這些說明非常有幫助，解釋得很清楚。

cues.en: Sometimes they give you examples to follow and sometimes they're not really so helpful.
cues.zh: 有時提供範例，有時則不太有幫助。

cues.en: Sometimes they're a little bit hard to interpret but it's always worth checking the help file just to make sure.
cues.zh: 有些說明不容易理解，但查看一下，確認有沒有用，總是值得的。

cues.en: So this thing says, so it gives an overview of the function with the possible inputs and then it says return the absolute value of the argument or the input.
cues.zh: 這裡會概述函數與可能的輸入，然後說明：傳回引數，也就是輸入值的絕對值。

cues.en: OK.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So that's actually pretty clear for this example.
cues.zh: 這個例子其實說得很清楚。

cues.en: Now there's also this plus sign here.
cues.zh: 這裡還有一個加號。

cues.en: You can often click on this plus sign and usually, not always but very often, there's more information there's more help.
cues.zh: 通常可以點加號，雖然不是每次，但常常會看到更多資訊、更多說明。

cues.en: Now in this case there is no more information.
cues.zh: 不過，這次沒有更多資訊。

cues.en: Okay so I'm going to close this.
cues.zh: 好，先關掉。

cues.en: Here's another function called range and now I'm basically just going to press shift tab and get some more information about this function.
cues.zh: 這是另一個函數 range。我按 Shift+Tab，查看這個函數的更多資訊。

cues.en: And so this actually does have a lot more information including suggestions for how to come up with examples for testing this function.
cues.zh: 這次確實有更多資訊，也提供如何設計範例、測試這個函數的建議。

cues.en: So this is just illustrating some of the ways that you can already get help yourself in Python. Another way to get help is to look online.
cues.zh: 以上示範了在 Python 裡自行取得協助的幾種方式。另一種方式是上網找。

cues.en: So Python has a huge worldwide community.
cues.zh: Python 有遍布全球的龐大社群。

cues.en: There are many many questions that have already been answered so it's likely that your question is already out there on the Internet.
cues.zh: 非常多問題都已經有人回答，所以你的問題很可能已經出現在網路上。

cues.en: A lot of these questions are asked and answered in English but you can also find Web sites in German
cues.zh: 很多問答使用英文，但也能找到德文，

cues.en: and Spanish and Turkish and Chinese and all sorts of languages where people are getting help from each other in Python.
cues.zh: 西班牙文、土耳其文、中文，以及各種語言的網站，讓大家互相協助解決 Python 問題。

cues.en: So when you're searching online make sure to use appropriate and specific key search terms.
cues.zh: 上網搜尋時，記得用適當、具體的關鍵字。

cues.en: That's going to help you get the right answer.
cues.zh: 這樣才能找到正確答案。

cues.zh: 我的小建議是，除了搜尋文字網頁，也搜尋圖片結果。我，

cues.zh: 包括 change、line color 和 python。

cues.zh: 這些都是重要的搜尋詞。

cues.zh: 搜尋看看，

cues.zh: 看看有多少結果。

cues.en: Now let me be clear that I am happy to engage with you in the Q&A forum, the question and answer forum, on this Web site.
cues.zh: 我也要說清楚，我很樂意在這個網站的 Q&A，也就是問答討論區，和你交流。

cues.en: However, I do encourage you to use the Q&A forum after you have already done some investigations yourself in Python and online.
cues.zh: 不過，我鼓勵你先自己在 Python 和網路上研究，再使用問答討論區。

cues.en: So before you post the question you should already search through the Q&A forum for your question and try using different search terms.
cues.zh: 發問前，先搜尋討論區裡的問題，也試試不同搜尋詞。

cues.en: It's very possible that someone has already asked the same question or a very similar question to what you are thinking about.
cues.zh: 很可能已經有人問過相同，或與你想問的非常類似的問題。

cues.en: And then if you post a new question please be specific include a screenshot or paste your code.
cues.zh: 如果要發新問題，請具體描述，附上截圖，或貼上程式碼。

cues.en: And if you're pasting your code into the Q&A box then you can use the code formatting tool so you select the code that you've pasted in and then you press this little,
cues.zh: 如果把程式碼貼進問答輸入框，可以使用程式碼格式工具：選取貼上的程式碼，再按這個小，

cues.zh: 如果你只問很籠統的問題，我其實沒辦法提供幫助。

cues.en: So if you want my help then you have to help me by including screenshots and or code and even better if you are referring to a specific part of the video.
